party_home.ip_welcome: Welcome to the intended parent portal
party_home.ip_intro: Follow your surrogacy journey, trust balance, and materials your case manager shares with you.
party_home.sm_intro: See your current case stage, reach your case manager, and keep your public profile up to date.
party_home.empty_body: Cases will appear here once created. Contact your case manager or admin if you need help.
party_home.focus_hint: Files, messages, and deeper progress live on the case detail page.
party_home.trust_hint: Each case has its own ledger; the total is for reference. See case detail for entries.
party_home.profile_body: Accurate public fields and photos help matching and communication. Update anytime.

pages.my_cases_intro: Placeholder. process_status labels can be localized (see sample stage).

am_dash.welcome_sub: Welcome back — here’s an overview of cases by pipeline stage.
am_dash.soft_delete_confirm: Soft-delete this case? It will hide from default lists; data is kept forever.
am_dash.error_soft_delete: Soft delete / restore failed. Try again.
am_dash.error_unauthorized: Sign in as a Case Manager first.
am_dash.error_data: Could not load data. Try again shortly.
am_dash.my_cases_intro: All related cases by default; filter to created by you or assigned to you.
am_dash.my_cases_section_note: Filter by IP, surrogate, stage, or search.
am_dash.search_placeholder: Search case ID / case manager email / intended parent email / surrogate email
am_dash.reassign_hint: {{count}} case(s) selected — bulk reassign to a case manager.

admin_dash.welcome_sub: View all cases and stage distribution.

admin_case.create_intro: Required: case manager, intended parent, initial stage, trust balance. Surrogate is optional. One intended parent may have multiple cases; each surrogate still links to one active case.
admin_case.error_create: Create failed. Check inputs and try again.
admin_case.error_unique_intended_parent: Could not create case for this intended parent. Try again or contact an admin.
admin_case.error_unique_surrogate: Could not create the case (surrogate conflict). Try again or pick another surrogate.

cm_case.create_intro: Case managers choose an intended parent (may already have other cases). You are auto-linked as primary case manager and added to the collaborators table; trust balance defaults to 0.
cm_case.error_create: Create failed. Check inputs and try again.
cm_case.error_unique_intended_parent: Could not create case for this intended parent. Try again.
cm_case.error_unique_surrogate: Could not create the case (surrogate conflict). Try again.
cm_case.error_case_manager_not_bound: Your account is not linked to a case manager entity yet. Ask an admin to bind it first.
cm_case.error_load_options: Could not load intended parent options.

admin_cm_workload.title: Case manager workload
admin_cm_workload.intro: Active cases per case manager (primary ∪ co-assigned, deduped; excludes soft-deleted cases). Unassigned cases are listed separately and are not included in each manager’s total.
admin_cm_workload.summary: Assigned {{assigned}} + unassigned {{unassigned}} = active total {{total}} (matches “All cases” below)
admin_cm_workload.error: Could not load workload. Try again later.

admin_accounts.intro_bind_entity: These rows are business records. Create logins under “Account management”. For unlinked rows use Link; for linked rows use Change binding — search by email in the dialog, pick a user, then confirm.
admin_accounts.intro_case_manager: Create case-manager business rows directly (no login required first), then Link / Change binding in the list. Or create the login under Account management first and bind here.
admin_accounts.intro_with_profile: Create business profiles directly (no login required first), then bind a login user when needed. You can also edit profiles here.
admin_accounts.create_cm_hint: Enter a business email to create; link a login account later if needed.
admin_accounts.soft_delete_hint: Soft delete hides the row from default lists and pickers. Data is kept forever and can be restored.
admin_accounts.soft_delete_confirm: Soft-delete this record? It will hide from default lists; data is kept forever.
admin_accounts.error_soft_delete: Soft delete / restore failed. Try again later.
admin_accounts.search_placeholder: Search by entity ID or email
admin_accounts.modal_intro: Search by email keyword, select a row, then confirm. Leave the field empty and search to list the most recent accounts.
admin_accounts.modal_hint_search: Enter a keyword and press Search, or search with an empty field to see recent accounts.
admin_accounts.modal_no_results: No users match. Create the account under “Account management” or try another keyword.
admin_accounts.modal_row_conflict: This account is already linked to another record of this type and cannot be used here.
admin_accounts.error_link_select_user: Select a user in the list first.
admin_accounts.error_link_user_not_found: No user with that email. Create the account under “Account management” first.
admin_accounts.error_link_entity_not_found: That business record was not found.
admin_accounts.error_link_user_conflict: That login is already linked to another record of this type.
admin_accounts.error_email_taken: That contact email already exists. Use another, or restore a soft-deleted profile.

party_cases.page_intro: Cases linked to your account are listed here.
party_cases.detail_intro: Read-only view of progress and profile summaries.
party_cases.empty: No cases are linked to your account yet. Contact your case manager if you need help.
party_cases.error_load: Could not load data. Try again later.
party_cases.error_not_found: Case not found or you cannot access it.
party_cases.progress_intro: Read-only journey stages. Stage form fields are only visible to your case manager.
party_cases.progress_unknown_stage: Status “{{stage}}” is outside the standard flow. Please contact your case manager.
party_cases.progress_docs_intro: Uploads marked client-visible by your team appear here.
party_cases.files_intro: Only files marked client-visible (visit photos, prenatal reports, escrow/legal contracts, etc.).
party_cases.trust_total_hint: Each case has its own trust; total is for reference.
party_cases.trust_section_intro: Shows this case’s trust balance and ledger rows marked client-visible by your case manager.
party_cases.trust_error_load: Could not load trust info. Try again later.

profile_photos.title: Photos
profile_photos.empty: No profile or gallery photos yet. The surrogate can upload them in My profile.

sm_profile.title: My profile
sm_profile.intro: Edit public fields and photos. Internal workflow fields are hidden.
sm_profile.photos_intro: Upload a profile photo or gallery images. Previews appear below after upload — click Save to persist.
sm_profile.album_upload_hint: Choose a file to append to the gallery (preview appears above after upload).

cm_entity.subtitle: Entity ID {{id}} · {{name}} (only parties on cases you manage)
cm_entity.error_not_found: Party not found or not on any case you can access.

admin_users.title: Account management
admin_users.subtitle: Create login accounts here. Link business profiles from the user list via Bind (pick an existing unbound profile or create new). Unlink if bound wrongly, then link again.
admin_users.ph_password_optional: New password to reset; leave blank to keep
admin_users.unbind_cm_confirm: Unlink the case manager role? The business profile is kept; only the login link is cleared.
admin_users.unbind_ip_confirm: Unlink the intended parent role? The business profile is kept; only the login link is cleared.
admin_users.unbind_sm_confirm: Unlink the surrogate role? The business profile is kept; only the login link is cleared.
admin_users.bind_modal_intro: Pick an unbound profile for {{email}}, or create a new one. Profiles left after unlinking appear in this list.
admin_users.bind_modal_empty: No unbound profiles. Use “Create new & link”, or create a profile in the business list first.
admin_users.bind_modal_pick_required: Select a profile, or use “Create new & link”.
admin_users.error_bind_conflict: This account is already linked to another profile of this type.
admin_users.error_bind_insert: Could not create a profile (email may already exist). Pick an unbound profile from the list.
admin_users.unbind_ok: Unlinked. You can link another role, or change the login from the business entity list.
admin_users.bind_already: This user already has that role.
admin_users.error_create: Create failed. Check input and try again.

workflow.bad_process_status: This case’s process_status in the database is not one of the canonical English stage names, so the flow cannot advance. In Hasura, set process_status to one of: {{stages}}
workflow.missing_fields_hint: {{count}} of {{total}} explicitly required fields are still empty:
workflow.scroll_more_fields: The form can be long—scroll as needed. Blanks are allowed; you can still advance.

case_detail.subtitle: GC/IP profiles are shown above; use this page for stage-specific case data only (not duplicated from personal profiles).
case_detail.cm_intro: Each case has one primary case manager and optional auxiliaries. After changing the primary, the previous primary stays as an auxiliary (you can remove them).
case_detail.cm_error_load: Could not load case managers. Try again later.
case_detail.cm_primary_changed: Primary changed; the previous primary remains as an auxiliary.
case_detail.cm_error_not_found: Case manager not found or soft-deleted.
case_detail.cm_error_cannot_remove_primary: Cannot remove the primary; change the primary first.
case_detail.no_gc_bound: No gestational carrier linked to this case yet.
case_detail.bind_gc_intro: Choose a gestational carrier to bind to this case. A carrier may appear on more than one case.
case_detail.bind_gc_no_options: No active carriers found. Create one under Admin → Surrogates first.
case_detail.bind_gc_error: Could not link carrier. Try again.
case_detail.bind_gc_error_taken: Could not link that carrier. Try again.
case_detail.replace_gc_intro: Use this when the case already has a carrier. This replaces the carrier on the same case (do not soft-delete and recreate the case). Unlink the current one and link another; the previous carrier loses portal access immediately. The change is recorded in history below.
case_detail.replace_gc_confirm: Replace the gestational carrier? This does not delete the case — only the carrier binding changes. The previous carrier will lose access immediately.
case_detail.replace_gc_error: Could not replace carrier. Try again.
case_detail.replace_gc_error_same: Pick a different carrier than the current one.
case_detail.profile_empty_gc: No surrogate profile yet. Use the button above to add details.
case_detail.profile_empty_ip: No intended parent profile yet. Use the button above to add details.
case_detail.error_unauthorized: Sign in with Case Manager access first.
case_detail.error_not_found: Case not found or you cannot access it.

am_workspace.section_intro: Canonical stages are listed on the left; you can revisit open stages. Later stages stay locked until the case advances. Fields may be left blank — save partial answers, or advance without filling everything.
am_workspace.profile_fields_hint: Use “View / edit profile” on the cards above for GC/IP details (only parties on this case). This panel is for case-stage fields only.
am_workspace.empty_fields: No fields are configured for this stage.
am_workspace.next_hint_incomplete: Blank fields are allowed. “Advance” saves the current form and moves to the next stage.
am_workspace.error_incomplete: Some fields marked required are still empty.
am_workspace.error_bad_flow: process_status is not on the canonical pipeline, so the case cannot be advanced.
am_workspace.error_advance_conflict: When advancing, edits must target the current stage only. Switch back to the current stage.
am_workspace.error_stage_locked: That stage is not open yet.
am_workspace.error_bad_request: Invalid request. Refresh and try again.
am_workspace.upload_error: Upload failed. Check your connection or verify Qiniu settings with an admin.
am_workspace.url_placeholder: Filled after upload, or paste a URL
am_workspace.url_hint: Files go to Qiniu via the portal-issued upload URL and credentials; you can paste an existing URL instead.

trust.section_intro: Posting a ledger entry updates the case balance. Use Seed for SeedTrust; overdraft is allowed with confirmation.
trust.preview_negative: This entry will leave a negative balance.
trust.confirm_negative: The trust balance will go below zero. Continue?
trust.error_load: Could not load the trust ledger.
trust.error_save: Could not post entry. Try again.
trust.error_edit: Could not update entry details. Try again.

files.section_intro: Upload medical/transfer/OB photos, prenatal reports, escrow & legal contracts, etc. Defaults to client-visible (shown on the client progress and files sections); switch to manager-only for internal materials.
files.error_url: Upload or paste a file URL first.
files.photo_hint: Upload medical, transfer, or OB visit photos; client-visible by default.

p1.archive_confirm: Soft-delete this case? It will hide from default lists; data is kept forever.
p1.cycles_empty: No cycles yet; use the button to fail current and start a new one.
p1.cycle_confirm: Mark the active cycle failed and open a new one?
p1.email_notify: Flag email notify on publish (send wiring comes later)

cm_parties.intro: Create profiles and manage IP/GC records on cases you own. Login accounts are still linked by admins.
cm_parties.empty: No profiles yet. Create one, or they appear after cases are linked.
cm_parties.soft_delete_confirm: Soft-delete this profile? It will hide from default lists; data is kept forever.
cm_parties.error_email_taken: That contact email already exists. Use another, or restore a soft-deleted profile.
cm_parties.error_cm_not_bound: Your account is not linked to a case manager entity.
